sections.text: مقدمة

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I2, which must be performed on an 
annually bases as indicated by Y1 in the title block.

The first draft is initiated by 
eng. 
عيد لطفي طلبة, tested by eng. 
Ibrahem Youssef Abdel Latif, مقبولة من قبل المهندس. 
Sayed Mahmoud Hussein Farag: general director, 
revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader 
El Naggar & Saad Mahmoud Bassuni, and 
approved by eng. 
Mokhtar Abd El-Latif Mady: 
head sector of Ataka PS.

تم قبول هذه الوثيقة من قبل المهندس.
 Samir Abdel Gilel: EDEPC 
inspection and 
 quality control general director & MPIS coordinator, and 
 certified by accountant: Mahmoud Mohamed Soliman EDEPC admin. & financial 
 inspection, quality control general director and supervisor of inspection & 
 quality control's head sector.
احتياطات السلامة

A work order must be issued and the qualified maintenance 
 staff should carry the suitable safety category.
مطلوب سياج أمان مع علامات تحذيرية تحيط بمنطقة العمل.
Wear your safety and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes ... etc.

Before starting 
 any work on the motor, check that it is switched off and blocked up for 
 switching on again.

Isolation and proper 
 earthing is required

sections.text: العمل المراد تنفيذه
Measure the vibration and noise level.
Clean the heat exchanger.
Check the bearing visually.
Grease the bearing.
Measure the insulation resistance for stator winding.

Clean the inside terminal box, and retighten bolts and ground 
 them.
General cleaning.
